description: Form W-9 page 1: form fields, Part I/II headings, the certification list and the signature row. The SSN boxes take a digit keypad and no autofill token (#281); a box that asks for city, state and ZIP at once, and a payee code, get neither.

heading.text: Request for Taxpayer Identification Number and Certification

items: The number shown on this form is my correct taxpayer identification number (or I am waiting for a number to be issued to me); and

I am a U.S. citizen or other U.S. person (defined below); and
The FATCA code(s) entered on this form (if any) indicating that I am exempt from FATCA reporting is correct.
